title: 航空可持續燃料相容性
summary: 以「區分燃料能量、材料相容性與資格證據」為主線，在虛構燃料批次性質與相容性資料室中依序完成燃料批次與資格文件身份、質量摻配的熱值模型、密度量測的不確定度、批次及試片取樣代表性、燃料性質變更的系統影響及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Distinguish fuel energy, material compatibility and qualification evidence in a Fictional fuel-property and compatibility data room, progressing through Fuel-batch and qualification-document identity, Mass-blend heating-value model, Density-measurement uncertainty, Batch and coupon representativeness, System impact of changed fuel properties, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.
